defaultContent.title: Care that fits your family's day.
defaultContent.description: More than Day Care: a 5,000 sq ft dedicated Day Care with 100+ beds, in-house kitchen, infirmary, CCTV and ten developmental activities.
defaultContent.lead: At Dolphin Kids, we believe that every moment in a child's day is an opportunity to learn, explore, develop and grow. Our Day Care brings together nurturing care, structured activities, age-appropriate learning, nutritious meals and thoughtfully designed recreational spaces.

images.alt: Children taking part in activities at Dolphin Kids

defaultContent.stat_text: sq ft dedicated to Day Care, within a campus of 20,000 sq ft indoors and 10,000 sq ft of green space.
defaultContent.arrange_title: Care that fits your family's day.
defaultContent.main_text: From 20 months, for families who need a full, well-paced day. Open to children who attend Dolphin Kids and to children from other schools in Greater Noida.
defaultContent.main_note: Day Care timings, facility-based fees and transport information are published below. Ask our team to confirm operating days and pickup arrangements for your location.
defaultContent.extended_highlight: One campus. One continuous learning journey.
defaultContent.extended_text: Children enrolled in Dolphin Kids School, Dolphin International School or other educational setups operated by the Dolphin Group can extend their school hours on the same campus, subject to campus availability.
extended_points: Seamless transition from regular school to Day Care
No additional transport between school and Day Care
A familiar campus and familiar faces
defaultContent.activities_title: Beyond childcare. Discovering talents, building confidence.
defaultContent.activities_lead: Ten programmes, each chosen for what it grows: confidence, communication, coordination, creativity, discipline, teamwork and independent thinking.
defaultContent.activities_note: Photographs are from the Dolphin Kids campus gallery and show the school environment, not necessarily the named activity.

activities.title: Personality Development and Confidence Building
activities.text: Show-and-tell, small responsibilities and gentle stage moments help children speak up, take turns and believe their ideas matter.

activities.title: Dance and Movement
activities.text: Rhythm, counting beats and following sequences turn energy into coordination, memory and joyful self-expression.

activities.title: Karate and Self-Defence
activities.text: Age-appropriate drills teach focus, respect, balance and body awareness, with the emphasis on discipline rather than contact.

activities.title: Montessori-Based Learning and Training
activities.text: Practical-life and sensorial materials let children work at their own pace, finish what they start and grow in concentration.
activities.builds: Independent thinking · Concentration · Fine motor skills

activities.title: Basketball
activities.text: Dribbling, passing and simple team games build hand-eye coordination, spatial awareness and the habit of playing fair.

activities.title: Language Development and Accent Training
activities.text: Conversation circles, stories, rhymes and clear pronunciation practice grow vocabulary and the confidence to be understood.

activities.title: Academic Assistance and Homework Support
activities.text: A quiet, supervised slot to complete school work, ask for help and build calm study routines.

activities.title: Indoor Play Zones
activities.text: Climbing, building and imaginative play in air-conditioned rooms, so movement continues whatever the weather.
activities.builds: Gross motor skills · Creativity · Social play

activities.title: Outdoor Play Zones
activities.text: Fresh air, open ground and nature-led discovery, with the supervision and pace adjusted to each age group.

activities.title: Badminton
activities.text: Light racquets and soft shuttles develop timing, footwork and patience.

care.title: Rest that is respected
care.text: More than 100 beds across separate, age-appropriate rooms, so nap time follows each child's rhythm rather than the clock.

care.title: Food from our own kitchen
care.text: A nutritious lunch prepared in a dedicated in-house kitchen with fresh ingredients and high standards of food hygiene.

care.title: A dedicated infirmary
care.text: A quiet space set aside for a child who feels unwell, so they can rest under supervision while parents are contacted.

care.title: CCTV surveillance
care.text: Day Care areas are covered by CCTV. Access to footage is governed by school policy and child-privacy safeguards.

care.title: Indoor and outdoor play
care.text: Air-conditioned indoor play zones alongside outdoor play areas on the same campus.

care.title: Comfortable, powered spaces
care.text: Air-conditioning and power backup keep the day steady for the youngest children.
